subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

Her team played exceptionally __more well__ in the competition.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. well .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "exceptionally more well" in the sentence is grammatically incorrect because "more well" is not proper usage.
 
• The correct form should be "exceptionally well," as "well" is already an adverb used to describe the manner of the action.
 
• Adverbs like "exceptionally" are used to emphasize the degree of the quality described by another adverb, in this case, "well."

Correct sentence: *Her team played exceptionally well in the competition*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Words like "more" and "most" are used with comparative and superlative forms, but "well" does not follow this pattern. Instead, "better" (comparative) and "best" (superlative) are used for "well."
 
• **Example for comparative:** She plays better than her teammate.
 
• **Example for superlative:** She is the best player in the team.
